description.narrative: Stöd till uppbyggnad av nationell statistik i Moçambique, för stärkkta möjligheter till bra fakta om multidimensionell fattigdomsminskning. Stödet avser bidrag till en gemensam fond för statistik.
Support to national statistics in Mozambique, in order to promote better monitoring of multi-dimensiononal poverty reduction in Mozambique. Financing of a common fund of statistics.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: INE is assessed to be one of the stronger Statistical Agencies in Africa, and does well in comparison to other state institutions in Mozambique. They have made considerable efforts during the period to keep track on its overall implementation of the strategic national statistics plan - despite the fact that it has also started its most intensive operation every ten years, the population and housing census.
Some of the major results from the period are:
1) Completion of the 2014-2015 business registry CEMPRE; 2) The start-up and ongoing efforts in building of an integrated system for sector statistics, 3) Completion of a pilot census and cartography for the 2017 census 4) Expansion of the Consumer Price Index (Índice de Preços no Consumidor, IPC) 5) Completed data collection for the main household budget survey (Inquerito Orcamental Familial, IOF) and publishing of initial analysis built on the first data 6) Improvements in terms of RBM-based planning and budgeting within INE (with support from a Swedish contracted consultant). This will result in increased transparency and will facilitate accountability of INEs reporting.
For the whole statistics system the timely publication of statistics has decreased somewhat during 2016 as compared to 2015. For INE the same figure actually goes up - from 70,2 percent in 2015 to 87,8 percent in 2016, whereas the Ministry of Finance has the lowest level of compliance with set publishing dates for their statistics.
The lack of external financing of the census was a general concern for INE and consumed a lot of the staff's time.
Sweden is an active and engaged partner both to the strategic statistics plan as to the census. There is an already agreed support to INE from late 2016 to end 2019 also supporting the same National Strategic Plan for Statistics and substituting this contribution.
The audit for 2016 was not yet ready at the time of completion, but will be analysed and approved in relation to the new INE support 2016-2019 that replaces this contribution.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
